column1: Flickering lights frustrated the focused photographer's careful composition attempts.
Whistling winds whipped through weathered shutters during stormy nights.
Sparkling streams splashed softly against smooth limestone river rocks.
Marching bands made magnificent music throughout the crowded stadium.
Heavy hail struck  the hillside, hiding the sound of hurried footsteps.
Giggling children grabbed colorful balloons from the party decorator.
Curious cats carefully climbed over slippery ceramic roof tiles.
Playful pandas picked perfectly ripe bamboo shoots for breakfast.
Dancing dolphins dove through crystal clear tropical ocean waves.
The scientist examined subtle shadows sliding along the metal surface.
